services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks

services.title: Tap & Toilet Repairs

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated seeing customers ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: Rick Russell has been plumbing in and around Rotherham for over 15 years. He's completed thousands of repairs and installations, earning a solid reputation for honest pricing and no-nonsense workmanship. Rick genuinely cares about his neighbours — he answers emergency calls any time of day, and he won't sell you a job you don't need.
about_para_2: His customers keep coming back because Rick treats every boiler, pipe, and radiator as if it were in his own home. He arrives on time, gets the job done right, and leaves no mess behind. From emergency callouts to planned central heating upgrades, Rick's local knowledge and straightforward approach mean you know exactly what you're getting.
reviews_heading: What Rotherham Homeowners Say About Rick

reviews.text: Had a nightmare leak under the kitchen at 11pm on a Sunday. Rick picked up the phone, came out within an hour, and sorted it properly. No faffing about, just honest work. Charged a fair price too. Can't ask for better than that.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in right before Christmas. Rick diagnosed a dodgy pump, ordered the part, and fitted it next morning. The whole thing could've cost a fortune, but he repaired it instead of flogging me a new boiler I didn't need. That's the kind of bloke you want.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Been using Rick for five years now — servicing the boiler every autumn, odd repairs here and there. He's always reliable, always punctual, and always tells you straight if something's worth fixing or needs replacing. Best plumber I've had.
reviews.author: David P.
